abilities.description:
Normal Attack
Performs up to 5 rapid strikes.

Charged Attack
Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to unleash a flurry of sword ki.

Plunging Attack
Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground below, damaging enemies along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.

abilities.name: Kamisato Art: Hyouka
abilities.description: Summons blooming ice to launch nearby opponents, dealing AoE Cryo DMG.

abilities.name: Kamisato Art: Soumetsu
abilities.description:
Summons forth a snowstorm with flawless poise, unleashing a Frostflake Seki no To that moves forward continuously.

Frostflake Seki no To
·A storm of whirling icy winds that slashes repeatedly at every enemy it touches, dealing Cryo DMG.
·The snowstorm explodes after its duration ends, dealing AoE Cryo DMG.

passives.name: Amatsumi Kunitsumi Sanctification
passives.description: After using Kamisato Art: Hyouka, Kamisato Ayaka's Normal and Charged Attacks deal 30% increased DMG for 6s.

passives.name: Kanten Senmyou Blessing
passives.description:
When the Cryo application at the end of Kamisato Art: Senho hits an opponent, Kamisato Ayaka gains the following effects:
·Restores 10 Stamina
·Gains 18% Cryo DMG Bonus for 10s.
_curatorNotes: ↻ EFFECT RETIRED 2026-09-21 (manual-trigger retirement, docs/manual-trigger-retirement-round.md). passive: Kanten Senmyou Blessing — effects[0] (buff, stat `cryoDmgBonus`, value 18) carried `trigger: manual` and reached no surface. gcsim: `asc.go:34-59` — `makeA4CB()` is attached as an attack callback to the DASH's Cryo hit only (`dash.go:41-47`, `dashHitmark = 20`); it fires once per Senho, restores 10 stamina and adds CryoP +0.18 for 600f. Retained: that the trigger is the Senho dash's Cryo hit and that the parser has no dash hit at all — `run.ts:2198-2210` emits a `dash` action block and advances the clock, with no hit record, no `application[]` and no state opener, so `onHit` cannot reach it (`abilityType` admits only skill/burst/normal/charged/plunge). Record the values for a future dash primitive: CryoP +18%, 600f, once per dash, gcsim `ayaka-a4`. ⚠️ ⛔ Do not reach for `trigger: passive` as a substitute — it would print a flat +18% Cryo DMG Bonus on the always-on chip, which is false before her first dash and false again 10s after each one. This is the brief's own RETIRE example in a different costume. It is not a DEFER either: a dash-hit trigger is neither of the two queued primitives.

constellations.name: Snowswept Sakura
constellations.description: When Kamisato Ayaka's Normal or Charged Attacks deal Cryo DMG to opponents, it has a 50% chance of decreasing the CD of Kamisato Art: Hyouka by 0.3s. This effect can occur once every 0.1s.

notModeled.reason: This cuts the cooldown on a 50% chance. The Rotation Planner doesn't simulate chance, so the same rotation always draws the same bars for everyone.
